name: You're Not Her
text: Give to the Heather Douglas player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Heather Douglas → remove You're Not Her from the game. • Discard each card in your hand with a printed [mental] resource (to a maximum of 3 cards). If no cards were discarded this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

flavor: Moondragon faces a battle in her mind against the demonic Dragon of the Moon. If she loses, it could spell the end for the heroes.
name: Dark Side of the Moon
text: Forced Interrupt: When the round ends, deal 1 damage to each player.

flavor: “The Dragon gained a foothold in me. At first its influence was subtle... then more intense. In a moment of weakness, I let it take control.” -Moondragon
name: Dragon of the Moon
text: Incite 1. Retaliate. Moondragon cannot resolve her "Dragon of the Moon" ability. (Moondragon's nemesis minion.)

name: Figment Unfragmented
text:
When Revealed: If Dragon of the Moon is in play, heal all damage from it. Otherwise, summon Dragon of the Moon and reveal it.
[star] Boost: After this activation ends, shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

flavor: “Oh dear, dear, dear. Someone flinched.” -Dragon of the Moon
name: Treacherous Will
text:
When Revealed: Discard an ally you control. If no allies were discarded this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.
